verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has a documented public API. It covers API credentials with configurable permissions, endpoints for customers, screening (sync, async and batch), cases, audit trails, exports, monitoring and transactions, plus rate-limit headers, versioning policy, a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema. A probe retrieved a valid OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema at /openapi/mesh-api.json, so the 404s on the guessed default paths are not a contradiction. Missing for 10: hands-on authenticated API operations or independent user corroboration that the API works end-to-end.
